dialogues.speaker: Berbere
dialogues.text: If I had the money, I would buy all the spices in Sumeru, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Berbere
dialogues.text: Merchants like me who come from the desert actually rarely trade in spices.

dialogues.speaker: Berbere
dialogues.text: Since we can go in and out of the desert, selling specialty goods is a no-brainer for us.

dialogues.speaker: Berbere
dialogues.text: But I really like the spices of Sumeru. Different combinations and proportions create a new delicacy every time!

dialogues.speaker: Berbere
dialogues.text: You can't find this sort of exquisite flavor outside of Sumeru, can you?

dialogues.speaker: Berbere
dialogues.text: Bye, hope you find your scent of Sumeru soon!
